title: RBI Amends Commercial Bank Deposit Interest Rate Rules and LCR Framework from October 1, 2026
description: RBI's Second Amendment Directions, 2026 revise commercial bank deposit rate disclosures and permit differential bulk deposit rates under the LCR framework from 1 October 2026.The post RBI Amends Commercial Bank Deposit Interest Rate Rules and LCR Framework from October 1, 2026 appeared first on TaxGuru.
